facts.text: PlayTableSimEnv is a gym.Env subclass
The constructor takes bullet_time_step and control_freq (default 30) and sets action_repeat to int(bullet_time_step // control_freq)
The play_table_env configuration sets bullet_time_step 240.0 and control_freq 30
initialize_bullet sets the physics timestep to 1.0 / bullet_time_step
reset(scene_obs, robot_obs) resets the scene and robot, advances one physics step and returns get_obs()
seed(seed) sets np_random with gym.utils.seeding.np_random and returns [seed]
step(action) applies robot.apply_action(action), advances physics action_repeat times, steps the scene and returns obs, 0, False, info
get_camera_obs renders every camera to an rgb and a depth array
get_obs returns the camera observations and the robot and scene state observations
get_state_obs returns robot_obs from Robot.get_observation() and scene_obs from PlayTableScene.get_obs()
get_info returns robot_info and, when use_scene_info is set, scene_info
Robot.get_observation returns the tcp position, the tcp orientation, the gripper opening width, the seven arm joint states and the gripper action
Robot.apply_action accepts the dict types joint_rel, joint_abs, cartesian_rel and cartesian_abs, plus a raw relative action array
The relative action scales default to max_rel_pos 0.02 and max_rel_orn 0.05
relative_to_absolute multiplies the relative position by max_rel_pos and the relative orientation by max_rel_orn
The gripper action must be -1 or 1
The configured gripper joint limits are 0 to 0.04
The panda configuration sets euler_obs true, so the tcp orientation is three Euler angles
The static camera is configured at 200 by 200 pixels
The gripper camera is configured at 84 by 84 pixels
The tactile camera is configured at 120 by 160 pixels
PlayTableScene.get_obs concatenates door, button, switch, light and movable-object states
get_env loads the dataset's merged Hydra configuration and instantiates the environment

determinism.notes: the upstream seed() feeds gym.utils.seeding.np_random and the fake seeds Python's random.Random; one implementation repeats a scene draw for one seed, but the two generators differ, so a seed does not give the same trajectory on the fake and on a pybullet run

gaps: no pybullet rigid-body dynamics, contacts, inverse kinematics, motors or sensors: the fake advances a kinematic tcp pose and a small scene state, so objects never move and contacts are not computed

the camera arrays are 4x4 RGB and 4x4 depth placeholders; the configured static camera is 200x200 and the gripper camera 84x84 (conf/cameras/cameras/static.yaml:7-8 and gripper.yaml:7-8), so NOT COVERED: the full-resolution rgb and depth camera arrays
the scene model is one door, one button, one switch, one light and three movable poses, not the configured CALVIN scene objects; scene_obs is a simplified flat list
the upstream reset(scene_obs, robot_obs) inputs are not exposed by the bridge's legacy reset path: only a seed reaches the environment, and reset options are not forwarded
the fake was never compared with a pybullet run: the upstream package needs pybullet, EGL and a dataset directory and was not installed or run where the gate ran
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state or set_state

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the world state is kept and stays readable
